description: Approve a pending event. Promotes a pending (auto-discovered) event to usable so metrics can query it (`pending` → `0`).

folder.description: Optional folder name grouping items in the dashboard. Alphanumeric, `_` or `-` (no `/`). Part of the SDK lookup key (`<folder>/<name>`).

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

properties.description: Replaces the full property set (no merge). Omit to leave properties unchanged.

items.description: One typed property declared on a catalogued event.

required.description: Whether the property must be present on every emitted event.

type.description: Value type of the property as recorded on the event.

name: metrics_events_approve
